messages:
nina (Finance): noticed duplicate invoices in NetSuite from last night's batch. looks like some records have null external_source_id and were re-ingested by backfill.

sam (Revenue Ops): yikes. any quick identifiers so we can pause the right jobs? :grimacing: 

eli (Eng): two examples: stripe_inv_01K9abcT and stripe_inv_01K9pqrs. webhook handler logs show events processed with 200 but payloads lacked idempotency/source fields. suspect signing-secret rotation hit an old shim that accepted everything.

rachel (SRE): deploy-bot: scale down cron/billing-backfill?
deploy-bot: cronjob "billing-backfill" scaled to 0 (requested by rachel).

eli (Eng): patch ready: old shim should 401 on signature mismatch. current hotfix returns 200 + cached response. PR https://git.internal/r/webhook/shim/pull/117

nina (Finance): how many dupes? the nightly duplication report flags 38 invoices so far.

sam (Revenue Ops): can we auto-void or create credit memos for small accounts and route enterprises to AR?
nina (Finance): yes. auto-resolution for amounts < $200. enterprise flagged for manual review. i'll export list.

rachel (SRE): detection query ran: 42 netSuite invoices with null external_source_id in window 2025-11-03T00:30Z -> 2025-11-04T06:00Z.

eli (Eng): immediate checklist executed: paused backfill, deployed shim patch to return 401 on bad signature, added Sentry capture for raw payloads. staging replays look idempotent.

sam (Revenue Ops): starting controlled replay for non-enterprise customers only.

rachel (SRE): replay in progress for 30 events. monitoring for duplicate creation. so far zero new duplicates.

nina (Finance): auto-credited 30 invoices. 12 enterprise invoices remain for AR review. I've DM'd the AR team.

eli (Eng): follow-ups: add CI test for signature rotation scenario, backfill should skip rows where external_source_id is null, metric webhook_missing_source_count with alert > 5/min. creating ticket BILL-1023.

sam (Revenue Ops): updated runbook: include secret rotation precheck (verify shim returns 401), detection query steps, AR sign-off requirement for enterprise replays.

nina (Finance): thanks team. please confirm AR updates and we'll close the loop once enterprise credits processed. :heart:
